summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping, exported it from the Databricks package and the profiles package, and registered it directly after the token mapping in profile_mappings. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim checks, token-over-OAuth selection, OAuth selection, profile output, env-var outputs, and override protection. Tests were not run and no commits were made, per instructions; verification was by reading the code only.
